title: How much video does $19 buy? Nightshift plans, in minutes.

facts.quote: Nightshift runs on credits. A plan brings a monthly allowance; one-time packs top up with or without a plan.
Quote5 min × 60 credits a minute300 credits
No run is quoted below 30 credits.
Your 100 free credits cover about 1 min of finished video at this rate.

Plus$19a month
2,000 credits / month≈ 33 min of finished video a month at the current per-minute rate

Pro$49a month
6,000 credits / month≈ 100 min of finished video a month at the current per-minute rate

Business$129a month
18,000 credits / month≈ 300 min of finished video a month at the current per-minute rate
Plans are billed monthly. Cancel any time.
Plan credits are valid for the billing period they arrive in and do not roll over.
Top-up packs are one-time payments and never renew.
Every upload is private, and nothing goes public unless you make it public or turn on a setting that does.
Pay for what you make. Never for a failure.
